about: The hills' canopy gate per theme (r441). A theme takes the first entry whose 'match' words it contains (whole words, any case), else 'default'. gate: whether ai_page.canopy refuses a hills strip and paints the next seed (up to tries); off = the first seed layer.py takes. status: tested = measured (seeds, where), untested = an estimate, its 'why' the reasoning. strips: hills strips painted for the layer (the gate's cost; ~18 s each warm, ~45 s with the inpaint model's load). recommend: ai_page flags that suit the theme (examples.sh's, where it has one). A new measure: tools/r441-hills-themes/themes.py OUT --only NAME, then edit the entry and its status.

themes.name: forest
themes.seeds: 7020-7049 (r384, colours 7d8aa3,4f6f5c,1d3328: 5/30 pass); 7020-7029 (r441, default colours: 0/10, fallback keeps 7021)
themes.looks: round crowns on about a sixth; flat hills, cartoon conifers or one big tree on the rest
themes.why: the gate was built for this theme: its fallback keeps the most wooded strip

themes.name: autumn
themes.looks: autumn fields, single orange trees on 4, blob groves on 3
themes.why: the gate passed 7027's black blobs and refused the best trees (7021, 7023, 7026): the first seed is as good
themes.recommend: default kinds; warm --colours and --sky for dusk

themes.name: desert
themes.looks: dunes and mesas on every seed, no tree: the theme
themes.why: the gate reads texture: it passed striated rock; every seed is on theme

themes.name: snow
themes.looks: dark ridges, some with snowy peaks, no tree: the theme
themes.why: the gate passed snow-streaked peaks, not trees; every seed is on theme

themes.name: ruins
themes.looks: buildings and ruins on 6, black blob trees on 3
themes.why: the gate passes buildings as a canopy; with examples.sh's kinds the page has no hills at all

themes.name: jungle
themes.looks: flat green hills on 7, big round leaf crowns across the width on 7024, a few giant leaves on 7025
themes.why: the gate's pick (7024, a jungle canopy) beats the first seed's bare hills

themes.name: beach
themes.seeds: 7020-7029 (r457, 'tropical beach, warm sunny afternoon', default kinds)
themes.looks: green mounds over a sand or grass band, no tree; the fallback (7024) no better than 7020
themes.why: the gate passes none and its fallback is no better than the first seed: 10 tries for nothing; examples.sh's beach kinds have no hills

themes.name: night
themes.looks: dark ridges over green fields, black mounds on 2; the fallback (7025) bright green, the least night-like
themes.why: the gate passes none and its fallback is worse than the first seed. A night theme naming woods takes the forest entry first
themes.recommend: --sky for the night (SD paints a pale sky); keep layers darker than it

themes.name: default
themes.why: off the forest every tested theme's gate pick was no better than its first seed (r441): an unknown theme takes the first seed until measured
themes.recommend: measure it: tools/r441-hills-themes/themes.py OUT, add an entry
